create_rpc_host: create a moolib Rpc host that listens on a TCP address and registers callable functions
define_rpc_function: define a remote callable function on an Rpc endpoint using the define method
connect_rpc_client: connect an Rpc client to a remote Rpc host by address
call_async_rpc: call a remote function asynchronously on an Rpc host and retrieve the result via a Future
call_sync_rpc: call a remote function synchronously on an Rpc host and return the result directly
